name: performance-health
description: performance-health CLI surface. Single source of truth for the scenario's command shape: schema-validated against cli-manifest/v1 and cross-validated against the proto descriptors at test time. Loaded by cli/main.go via cliapp.LoadFromManifest. Each group mirrors one API domain; the shared ScenarioValidationService procedures are intentionally omitted (they are the test-genie delegation surface, not a developer CLI verb).

groups.name: readiness
groups.description: Validate a scenario's capture-tier readiness and apply format-preserving fixes toward Tier 1

commands.name: validate
commands.description: Decide a scenario's reachable capture tier from Code Facts and report missing Tier-1 perf-build infra

flags.name: path
flags.description: Filesystem path to validate instead of a scenario slug

commands.name: fix
commands.description: Preview the format-preserving edits readiness would apply to move a scenario toward Tier 1 (dry-run)

flags.name: path
flags.description: Filesystem path to fix instead of a scenario slug

flags.name: rule
flags.description: Restrict the fix to a finding code (repeatable)

commands.name: apply
commands.description: Apply the format-preserving readiness edits to move a scenario toward Tier 1

flags.name: path
flags.description: Filesystem path to fix instead of a scenario slug

flags.name: rule
flags.description: Restrict the fix to a finding code (repeatable)

groups.name: audit
groups.description: Orchestrate a profile-mode perf capture of a scenario (cleanly skips when capture is impossible)

commands.name: run
commands.description: Restart a scenario in profile build mode, drive a BAS perf capture, and restore the default build

flags.name: workflow
flags.description: BAS recorded-workflow slug for the interaction (default navigate+mount-settle)

groups.name: lighthouse
groups.description: Score a scenario's UI with Lighthouse (silent-skip when unavailable)

commands.name: run
commands.description: Run Lighthouse against a scenario's pages and report category scores plus threshold violations

groups.name: benchmark
groups.description: Time a scenario's build surfaces against thresholds

commands.name: run
commands.description: Time go build and the UI build against thresholds and report per-surface timings

groups.name: analysis
groups.description: Analyze captured perf traces into deterministic, located findings

commands.name: analyze
commands.description: Parse a captured perf trace into a per-component table plus deterministic, located findings

positionals.name: scenario
positionals.description: Scenario slug the trace belongs to

flags.name: trace
flags.description: Storage key / path of the captured performance.json trace

commands.name: compare
commands.description: Diff two perf traces of the same interaction (component-commit delta + long-task delta)

positionals.name: scenario
positionals.description: Scenario slug the traces belong to

groups.name: budget
groups.description: Read, write, and check per-scenario performance budgets

commands.name: get
commands.description: Read a scenario's declared performance budget

flags.name: go-build-max-ms
flags.description: Maximum go build time in milliseconds

flags.name: ui-build-max-ms
flags.description: Maximum UI build time in milliseconds

flags.name: lcp-max-ms
flags.description: Maximum Largest Contentful Paint in milliseconds

flags.name: p95-max-ms
flags.description: Maximum p95 interaction/latency in milliseconds (where measured)

flags.name: component-commit-avg-max-ms
flags.description: Maximum per-component average commit time in milliseconds

flags.name: component-commit-max-ms
flags.description: Maximum per-component (slowest) commit time in milliseconds

flags.name: ratchet
flags.description: Tighten-only: reject any future write that loosens this budget

commands.name: check
commands.description: Check a scenario's latest measurements against its budget (the baseline-diff regression gate)

groups.name: trend
groups.description: Read a scenario's persisted performance trend

commands.name: get
commands.description: Read the persisted performance samples for a scenario, newest first

groups.name: fleet
groups.description: Scan the fleet for performance offenders (deterministic, structured queries)

commands.name: scan
commands.description: Grade the requested scenarios (or every discovered scenario) and roll up offender lists plus the capture-tier distribution

flags.name: scenario
flags.description: Restrict the scan to a scenario slug (repeatable)

flags.name: view
flags.description: Offender view: all (default), no-budget, slowest, regressed, tiers

flags.name: limit
flags.description: Cap the number of rows for the slowest view (0 = all)

groups.name: startup
groups.description: Benchmark scenario startup performance and read the persisted trend (decoupled from validation; never run by a test phase)

commands.name: measure
commands.description: Restart a scenario and record its startup performance (time-to-healthy + resource envelope). This restarts the target scenario.

flags.name: timeout
flags.description: Max seconds to wait for the scenario to report healthy (0 = default)

commands.name: trend
commands.description: Read a scenario's persisted startup-performance measurements, newest first

positionals.name: scenario
positionals.description: Scenario slug to read the trend for

omitted.reason: Shared cross-scenario validation surface for test-genie delegation (axes ①/③); the developer CLI uses `readiness validate`, which targets the scenario-native ReadinessService.
